title: Book Three · Chapter 51: The Other Friends
story:
Leo chooses a small packet of tea for his grandmother.

He asks the price before he asks the shopkeeper to wrap it. There is still a little money left afterward. He puts it deep in his pocket.

Outside, Ronan takes the road toward the old market with him.

For a while, they do not talk. The sun is high, and they stay near the shade of the shop fronts.

Then Leo says, “You and Kai play together a lot.”

“At school.”

“I saw.”

Ronan looks at him.

“You liked him.”

“I do.”

Leo turns the tea packet in his hands.

“On Sunday, I thought we would be on the same side first.”

“So did I. Then the others were there.”

“Yes.”

They pass a closed shop. Ronan can see both of them in its dark window.

“You talked to Anna for a long time yesterday,” he says.

Leo looks surprised.

“About the station roof?”

“And the other city.”

Leo stops near the corner. For a second, Ronan wishes he had not said it.

Then Leo smiles a little.

“You asked me to meet her.”

“I know.”

“Should I only say hello?”

Ronan laughs, but his face feels warm.

“No.”

Leo laughs too. They start walking again.

“You had more stories,” Ronan says after a while.

“You have her beside your desk every day.”

Ronan looks down at his shoes. He has not thought about it that way.

He thinks of the wall outside the hall. He and Anna sat there without Leo. He did not need to travel far to do that.

At the next crossing, they wait beside each other. A man carries a basket past them. Then the road clears.

“I liked this morning,” Leo says.

“Me too.”

“Next time, tell me which side you're on.”

“Next time, pass where I am going.”

“Tell me where that is.”

They grin at each other and cross.

Near the grandmother's home, Leo slows. His aunt wants him there for lunch, then a family afternoon. He needs to pack his bag tonight.

Ronan stops at the doorway.

“Tomorrow, outside the station?”

“Before half past nine. The bus is at ten.”

“I will be there.”

Leo shifts the tea packet under one arm and reaches for the door.

“I want you to visit us too,” he says. “Not tomorrow. Another time.”

“I need to ask at home.”

“I know.”

From inside, the grandmother calls Leo's name. He answers and turns back once.

“Bring your feet.”

Ronan laughs. Leo goes inside with the tea. Ronan waits until the door closes, then starts toward West Lane.

At the busy corner, he leaves room for a cart and takes the quieter side of the road home.
studyGuide:
## 词句提示

wrap＝包起来；shop front＝店铺正面；surprised＝惊讶的；another time＝另找一次机会。

## 理解问题

1. Leo和Ronan各自有一点在意什么？他们有没有把这种感觉直接说出来？
2. Leo为什么不能把最后一个下午也全部交给Ronan？明天约在哪里、什么时候见？

## 读句子

**Then the road clears.**

拆开看：Then / the road / clears.

然后／道路／空出来、可以通行了。
